_meta.rule: queue(view, standing) = transitions of the view's family whose from = view.state and whose roles meet standing; one item per transition; the door admits by the same predicate

sources.cc-table: the registry and CC table, or a cell the text states (it carries cc_ref)

_meta.guard: a guard cell lists what must be held, live or signed for the row to be admitted, as clauses in the grammar of tools/guard_grammar.py, each with the sections that state it and whether it says the whole statement; an empty list with source generic is a transition for which no guard is typed, which is not a claim that the text states none

well_founded.reading: no row's admission requires a row whose own admission requires it back

_meta.change: a change cell lists what the transition's row may do to the row it changes, as items in the grammar of tools/change_grammar.py, each with the sections that state it; a transition with none takes the default under `changes`

changes.default: replace: by=same_attester, link=ranked:references_attestation_id, reach=own_prior ; withdraw: cascade=*/ref:stand

_meta.count: a policy cell with `count` is derived from the family model's count cell: `cases` lists the arms that turn on something a stage does not key (the kind of identity, of group, the number of seats), each with its policy and rows
_meta.stages: a roles cell with `stages` gives each stage's or leaf's signers and `value` is their union; a policy cell with `stages` gives the policy of the stages that differ from `value`; a view that knows its stage is served from the stage
_meta.undo: an undo cell says whether this table offers a way back for the row the transition signs, the verb of that way back (`via`) and the policy it runs under (`policy`): selfAct is the signer alone, any other policy takes the others it names; false with source derived is a family whose lifecycle closes retraction, false with source gap is a family whose retraction this table does not list
_meta.widens_when: one rule reads every widens and confirm cell: the boolean never under-states, and `when` narrows it. widens.when is always, by_scope (a row signed at self scope does not widen, a row at any wider scope does) or by_scope_change (a replacing row widens when its scope is wider than the row it replaces, CC 4.4.3.3.1). confirm.when is always (the row widens at every scope, or this table offers no way back) or if_widens (a way back is offered, and the item is confirmed only when widens.when holds for the row as signed). A way back means this table offers a withdraw or recant of the row; a copy a peer took is not recalled
_meta.confirm: a confirm cell is true when the transition widens or has no way back: the item is confirmed before it is signed; false is one step
_meta.conditions: a roles cell with `conditions` carries the signer rule's conditions; not_subject closes the transition to a signer who is the row's subject
_meta.note: draft 0: states are the five retraction states of CC 2.4.1.1; a family with its own lifecycle (membership stages, the moderator election, the halt) refines these in its chapter model; gap cells mean the queue generator treats the transition as closed until the manifest says otherwise
